content: Good afternoon! Welcome to Riverview Medical Billing. How can I assist you today with your hospital account?
Hi, I just paid my surgery invoice last night but the online portal still shows a balance. Can you check if my payment went through?
Of course! To clarify, is this regarding invoice #2024-5811 for $4,250, billed under the name Daniel T. Schaffer and associated with your patient ID 0091123?
Yes, exactly. I paid with Zelle using my email dtschaffer@gmail.com and used the reference 'SCHAF4250.'

Thank you for confirming. I do see a Zelle payment of $4,250 with the reference 'SCHAF4250' received at 10:19 PM yesterday. Sometimes there's a 24-hour delay before your account reflects the update, but your payment is logged under Daniel T. Schaffer, email dtschaffer@gmail.com.
Will I get a confirmation email soon? I'm traveling tomorrow and need proof for my insurance.

Absolutely. A digital receipt was emailed to dtschaffer@gmail.com at 8:15 AM this morning. If it's not in your inbox, it may be in your spam folder. Let us know if you need it resent, especially since your travel date is imminent.
I see it now, thanks. Just to double-check, the payment went to Riverview's account ending in 3942, right?
Correct, your Zelle transfer was received into our Riverview Medical account ending in 3942. The transaction ID is ZL-20240605-2874 for your records.
Perfect, that's all I needed. Thanks for your help!
You're very welcome, Daniel! If you need anything else before your trip, just call our billing line at (415) 555-0193. Safe travels!
